beats.sub: Some shows ring a bell before every ad break. MinusPod can listen for it.

beats.head: Find the cue on any episode.
beats.sub: One scan surfaces the sounds that repeat at known ad breaks. Make a template from one.

beats.head: Templates live on the feed.
beats.sub: Intro, outro and ad-break cues, with health stats from every episode since.

beats.head: Or scan several episodes at once.
beats.sub: Candidates that recur across episodes, ranked by how often they sit at an ad break.

beats.head: Cuts snap to the cue.
beats.sub: A Cue snapped badge marks each edge the cue sharpened. Confirm or reject matches to tune the feed.

beats.head: Tune it globally or per feed.
beats.sub: Frequency band, prominence, confidence. Cue-only mode skips the model on shows that always chime.

beats.head: Audio cues
beats.sub: Mark it once. Every episode after lands on the chime.
